title: AI Supervisor Console — Full TUI Integration (Buddy as Autonomous, Human-Gated Trader)
goal: Transform the Buddy TUI from observability-only dashboard into an AI Supervisor Console — the human checkpoint layer that makes autonomous trading safe to leave running. Ship end-to-end: kill switch, pause/resume, dry-run↔live toggle, adjustment inbox (self-tuner human-gate), per-trade close, pre-trade veto window, gate trace panel, model staleness banner, rules/learnings viewer, and agent weight inspector. Retire silent self-tuner writes. Every feature wired end-to-end with integration test + code review + security review + performance benchmark. No story passes without specialist sub-agent sign-off.
context: Phase 90 closed the self-improvement loop (learnings → rules → config adjustments). Phase 91 closes the HUMAN loop: an operator-supervised override layer on top of Buddy's autonomy. Gap audit (2026-04-16): TUI today reads live from DataProvider (NAV, trades, agents, MTF, system health) and writes only through Config screen profile selector. Missing: kill switch, pause, mode toggle, per-trade close, pre-trade veto, adjustment approval, gate trace, staleness banner, rules viewer, RL weight inspector. Drivers: (a) 2026-04-15 10-trade losing streak from stale models ($2,637 loss) — soft penalties were insufficient, needed hard staleness block; (b) 2026-04-16 orphan-key bug in config_adjustments.json where 5/9 proposals had invalid ScannerConfig field names and cost $3,527 over 14 trades — needed human approval gate with schema validation. Both were preventable by a supervisor console.

agent_policy: FORBIDDEN: 'general-purpose' agent. Any sub-agent call MUST specify a subagent_type from the agent_roster below.
Every story MUST invoke at least one specialist for IMPLEMENTATION and one distinct specialist for REVIEW.
Ralph MUST NOT mark a story complete until both implementation and review agents have signed off in `notes` with timestamp.
If a story needs a capability not in the roster, Ralph MUST HALT and escalate rather than defaulting to general-purpose.
code_quality: All JSON file writes MUST be atomic: write to .tmp, then os.rename. No exceptions. (.claude/rules/improvement.md JSON Safety Gates)
All JSON file reads MUST be wrapped in try/except with graceful fallback to empty dict/list.
All OANDA API calls MUST use exponential backoff (base 1s, max 30s, jitter) with explicit timeouts (connect=5s, read=30s).
NEVER use bare except: or except Exception: pass — always log + re-raise or return explicit error status.
Every new ScannerConfig field MUST be added in THREE places: (a) dataclass field, (b) profile dict entries, (c) consumer getattr() calls. Missing any = dead feature. (Live Wiring Verification Gates)
Every new feature flag MUST have an end-to-end smoke test: profile dict → dataclass → consumer → log line confirmed in live scan output.
NEVER write to a ScannerConfig field without validating the field name against the dataclass first (orphan-key prevention, .claude/rules/improvement.md promoted 2026-04-16).
tui_policy: All destructive actions (kill, mode→live, reject adjustment) MUST show a confirmation modal with explicit typed confirmation or double-tap.
All TUI writes to backend state MUST be audit-logged to .claude/brain/strategic_log.md with ISO timestamp, actor='TUI', action, before/after values.
State flags (halted, scanner_paused, mode) MUST persist in .claude/state.json and survive TUI restart.
TUI MUST NEVER block the event loop on OANDA calls — use Textual @work workers.
completion_discipline: A story is NOT complete until ALL validation_commands exit 0 AND all definition_of_done checks pass.
Claude Ralph MUST emit <promise>COMPLETE_STORY_{id}</promise> only AFTER validation_commands have been executed and evidence logged.
A story that cannot pass validation MUST have passes stay false and notes updated with blocker reason.
No story may be marked complete based on 'should work' reasoning — only on recorded evidence.

userStories.title: Foundation: state.json schema extension + in-process event bus
userStories.description: Create the substrate every other story depends on. Extend .claude/state.json schema with supervisor flags (halted, scanner_paused, mode, last_actor). Build a lightweight in-process event bus at src/scanner/automation/event_bus.py for signal.pending / signal.executed / signal.rejected / adjustment.proposed / control.kill / control.pause / control.mode_change events. No network, no threads-per-event — asyncio.Queue-based with sync-publish/async-subscribe bridge for TUI consumption.

userStories.title: Flatten-all routine in ExecutionManager (panic-button backend)
userStories.description: Implement the backend of the kill switch. ExecutionManager.flatten_all() cancels every working order, then parallel market-closes every open position, respects exponential backoff on OANDA errors, sets halted=true on state, emits control.kill event. MUST be atomic in intent — if any close fails, retry with backoff; if all retries exhausted, return structured failure including which trades still open.

supporting_agents.role: Standard review

story_guidelines: flatten_all() MUST first set state.halted=true BEFORE any OANDA call, so no new scan cycle starts concurrently.
Then cancel all working (pending) orders in parallel via asyncio.gather with return_exceptions=True.
Then market-close all open positions in parallel.
Each OANDA call uses exponential backoff: base=1s, max=30s, jitter; max 5 retries.
NEVER retry on 4xx (client errors) — only 5xx/timeout/connection.
Return structured result: {orders_cancelled: int, orders_failed: list, positions_closed: int, positions_failed: list, duration_ms: int}.
Write audit entry to .claude/brain/strategic_log.md with timestamp, actor='TUI_KILL', full result.
Emit control.kill event on event_bus.
If any position fails to close after retries, leave halted=true, raise KillSwitchPartialFailure with details.

userStories.title: Performance benchmark — TUI refresh under scanner load
userStories.description: Benchmark the Supervisor Console under realistic scanner load. Requirement: TUI frame refresh < 100ms p95 and < 250ms p99 while scanner runs a full cycle across 28 pairs every 30 seconds, with kill switch response < 2s p99 (flatten triggered → all positions reported closed), and adjustment inbox render < 500ms for a batch of 50 pending adjustments. Identify bottlenecks (DataProvider lock contention, OANDA rate-limit pauses that block UI, snapshot deepcopy cost) and remediate. If target missed, story stays open.

supporting_agents.role: Fix any perf regression identified — lock contention, blocking calls on UI thread, slow widget refresh.

story_guidelines: Benchmark harness in tests/perf/bench_supervisor_console.py — pytest-benchmark or custom timeit loop.

userStories.title: Final reality check + Phase 91 evidence collection
userStories.description: The gate on Phase 91 closing. A dedicated reality check + evidence collection pass that independently verifies every one of the 19 prior stories actually shipped the thing it claimed to ship — not just that the validation command returned zero. Produces the phase evidence report at .claude/ralph/reports/phase91_evidence.md. If any story evidence fails independent verification, that story's passes flag reverts to false and Phase 91 does NOT close until re-verified.

story_guidelines: Reality Checker runs the VALIDATION commands for US-501..US-519 fresh, in order, and records each result.
